source_resolution.reason: Belkin et al. invoke Wendland (2004), Theorem 11.22. The full Rieger-Zwicknagl article and author dissertation give a cube-specific route based on Madych and Nelson (1992), Lemma 1, but neither supplies that lemma proof. The official Rieger PDF itself is readable in the browser, while the repository fetcher exhausted six attempts on its PDF URL. The mathematical claim is preserved; the required local power estimate is not proved.
source_resolution.search_summary: Six retrieval attempts for the official Rieger PDF were exhausted by the fetch checker; the full 27-page PDF is readable through the publisher browser route. The author dissertation independently confirms the cube route but also cites Madych and Nelson. ScienceDirect returned 403 for the Madych-Nelson paper, so the power estimate remains escalated.
source_resolution.prior_attempt_history: The inherited handoff reported five retries before compaction. This sidecar now records one initial retrieval and five recovery attempts with exact URLs and date-level outcomes; a later alternate-source search still did not supply the missing polynomial-reproduction proof.

alternatives.argument: No complete alternative proof of the Gaussian power-function estimate is available. The separate local fill-distance lemma proves only the random covering step and does not establish this estimate.

The local derivation reduces interpolation error to the Gaussian power function and converts a power-function estimate to the stated n/log n rate. The required Gaussian estimate remains unresolved, so the theorem is escalated.
